summary.text: Braille Diaz is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 93 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a 23-year-old Mount Kisco resident who works as a fire equipment inspector and is a volunteer firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Diaz says on his campaign website that he was raised in Mount Kisco from the age of four and graduated from Fox Lane High School.
The site says he studied philosophy and theology in Florence, Italy, and has worked for the Boys & Girls Club of Northern Westchester.
It also lists service on the Mount Kisco Ethics Board and experience working in the Bedford Town Court.
Diaz lists affordability, a regional health insurance marketplace, and holding criminals accountable among his priorities, according to his campaign website.
The site also lists support for volunteer fire and EMS recruitment, public transit safety and workforce development.
